title: More_signs
description: Adds more traffic signs to Minecraft
body:
More Signs

Enhance your Minecraft roads and cities!

Ever felt like your Minecraft cities were missing that final touch of realism? More Signs is a decorative mod for Forge 1.20.1 designed to give builders the tools they need to create organized, realistic traffic systems and urban environments.

Whether you are building a bustling metropolis or a quiet suburban neighborhood, this mod provides a variety of essential road signage and functional-looking traffic elements.
### Key Features:

    Comprehensive Road Signage: Includes Stop signs, Give Way (Yield) signs, Priority signs, and Parking markers.

    Customization Options: Every sign comes in two versions—with a pole for standalone placement, or without a pole to be mounted directly onto walls or custom structures.

    Traffic Control: Fully integrated traffic light blocks and procedures to help manage your "villager traffic."

    Modular Poles: Use the dedicated "Pole" block to create custom heights or unique support structures for your signage.

    Creative Organization: All items are neatly tucked away in a custom More Signs Creative Tab for easy access while building.

### Technical Details:

    Version: Minecraft 1.20.1

    Loader: Forge

    Focus: Aesthetics, Roleplay, and City Building
